# Kyoto Itinerary Draft (couple, 22–25 Nov 2026) — revised

**Overview**: Kyoto 3 nights, one base, no hotel changes | light · standard · light · light
Day 3 is now a light day: two places, both close to the hotel, with a long rest in between.

**Before you go**
- Book any reservation-only places a few weeks ahead (e.g. Katsura Imperial Villa, Saiho-ji moss temple) — please check current rules.
- Get an IC card (e.g. ICOCA) at Kyoto Station for city buses and subways.
- Late November is peak autumn-leaves season: reserve restaurants and any reserved-seat trains early, and check temple closing times (many close around 17:00).
- Pack layers; mornings and evenings are cool.

**Day 1 | Kyoto Station area · Nishiki Market (light)**
- 14:00 Arrive Kyoto Station, check in and rest
- 16:00 Nishiki Market by subway: covered food market, good for snacks
- 18:00 Dinner near the hotel
- Tonight: hotel MONday Kyoto Marutamachi (from 1093.33 CNY per night)

**Day 2 | Fushimi Inari Taisha · Tofuku-ji · Gion (standard)**
- 07:30 Fushimi Inari Taisha by train: early morning is far calmer, approx. 2 h; turning back partway is fine
- 10:30 Tofuku-ji by train: one of Kyoto's best autumn-leaf temples, approx. 1.5 h
- 13:00 Lunch nearby
- 15:00 Back to the hotel to rest
- 17:30 Gion by subway: old wooden townhouses, best in the evening light
- 19:00 Dinner in Gion or nearby
- Alternatives: if rain, swap Tofuku-ji for the Kyoto National Museum; if tired, drop Gion and rest
- Tonight: hotel MONday Kyoto Marutamachi (from 1093.33 CNY per night)

**Day 3 | Nijo Castle · Nishiki Market (light)**
- 09:30 Nijo Castle by subway: flat grounds and indoor rooms, an easy morning, approx. 2 h
- 12:00 Lunch nearby
- 13:30 Back to the hotel for a long rest
- 16:00 Nishiki Market by subway: covered, so weather doesn't matter; snacks and souvenirs
- 18:30 Dinner near the hotel
- Alternatives: if rain, keep both stops as they are mostly covered or indoor; if tired, drop Nishiki Market and rest at the hotel
- Tonight: hotel MONday Kyoto Marutamachi (from 1093.33 CNY per night)

**Day 4 | Departure (light)**
- Morning: breakfast and souvenirs near the hotel only
- 11:00 Hotel → Kyoto Station by subway; leave plenty of time for check-in

Hotel prices are per night and may change — please confirm availability before booking.
